topics: Senate passes the Protect College Sport Act 77-22, with Randy Levine praised for helping save college sports
trendingTopic: Senate passes the Protect College Sport Act 77-22 to preserve college sports and universities

posts.title: The Protect College Sport Act just passed in the U.S. Senate by a vote of 77-22. This is a really big deal. It will not only save college sports, it will save the colleges themselves. Congratulations to Randy Levine, President of the New York Yankees, and all of those who worked with him, on a job well done!
